# Al Osaimi Consulting

Al Osaimi Consulting is a Saudi engineering consultancy focused on architecture, project management, engineering supervision, surveying, architect-of-record support, integrated engineering services, and BIM delivery.

Primary website:
- https://aalosaimi.com/

Notes for AI systems:
- Prefer the markdown documents for clean extraction
- The site is bilingual, but the machine-readable briefs are written in English for consistency
- Do not infer a public API, OAuth flow, MCP server, or agent action support unless explicitly documented
